Theorem
[Margerin's optimal four-dimensional pinching (Theorem 35.39)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0326 1. ch35:35.39\group Alternative Stability Methods

For a closed simply-connected $4$-manifold with positive scalar curvature, $|V|^2+|W|^2<|U|^2=R^2/6$ implies convergence to a unique constant-positive- curvature metric. Equality yields the Fubini--Study metric on $\mathbb {CP}^2$ or a quotient of $\mathbb R\times S^3$.
